trickyParts: The plan test needs an Index Cond on the index node, not only the index name: with a text-only predicate Postgres reads the whole partial index asks_anchor_artifact_id (its predicate anchor is not null is implied), which names the index and has no Seq Scan.
The A1 fixture leaves block_id null so B's ask-block reconciliation never sees the row; the unrecorded 'dangling' control mark makes a sweep that errored or never ran fail.

The census calls pg_input_is_valid(anchor->>'artifact_id','uuid'), the cast's own input function (Postgres 16+, the supported floor), so it counts exactly what the index build refuses; a missing artifact_id is null and is counted by neither.
